rationale: The primary bearish thesis remains intact as HUM continues to trade on heavy relative volume (3.38x) near the bottom of its daily range (6.3%) and below the declining 5-minute 9-EMA ($392.85). Although price bounced off the recent $388.19 low, the latest 1-minute rebound stalled at $392.27 on tapering volume and rejected back to $391.69, keeping the lower-high structure intact. With 80 minutes left in the session and price below both entry and the 5-minute 9-EMA, holding allows for a potential retest of the session lows.
